title: Dokodemo Makibao: World Tour
synopsis: A spin-off of Midori no Makibao to celebrate the 30th anniversary of the series. It depicts "everyday races" such as "who can pick up the most trash at the beach" and "who can get to the basement of the department store first to get the food that is limited to just one person." (Source: ANN)

title: PetitCure: Precure Fairies Season 2
synopsis: The stage moves from the mysterious amusement park to a strange sweets paradise. Join Mofurun and Pollun as they explore this new place and meet new friends. (Source: Official Site, edited)

title: Dinoster: Gonglyongsuhodae 3rd Season
synopsis: Third season of Dinoster: Gonglyongsuhodae.

title: Di Ling Ai: Mo Shui Linglong
synopsis: All things possess a spirit, and the power of nature coalesced into various conscious fairies. However, due to humanity's neglect of nature and the awakening of suppressed powers, the fairies have been harmed. A human girl encounters a fairy from the depths of the water and they have known each other for many years. However, they cannot overcome the barrier between celestial and mortal. On a wondrous journey, the girl resolves to find her own power. She believes that humanity is also part of nature, and that there must be a way for humans and nature to coexist harmoniously. Can she protect nature? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun Mini Anime Gekijou
synopsis: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Sawaranaide Kotesashi-kun exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

title: Let's Go Kaiki-gumi
synopsis: The story of Let's Go Kaiki-gumi follows a nameless protagonist who is six times more vulnerable to spiritual phenomena than the average human being. One day, the protagonist encounters Mechako, a mysterious girl who runs the Kaiki-gumi, an organization that polices the behavior of the ghosts and monsters that threaten human beings, and he somehow gets roped into helping the Kaiki-gumi re-establish itself, resulting in all sorts of strange events and spooky shenanigans. (Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Mang Huang Ji (2026)
synopsis: Fate had never been kind to Ji Ning. Wracked by illnesses and infirm his entire life on Earth, Ning knew early on that he would die as a teenager. What he didn’t know was that there really was such a thing as life after death, and that the universe was a far larger place than he thought. A lucky twist of fate (one of the few in Ning’s life) meant that Ning was reborn into a world of Immortals and monsters, of Ki Refiners and powerful Fiendgods, a world where Dynasties lasted for millions of years. A world which is both greater and yet also smaller than he ever could imagine. He would have the opportunity to join them, and in this life, Ning swore to himself, he would never let himself be weak again! The Era he was born into was a Desolate one, but Ning would make it his era. (Source: Novel Update)

title: Oshirimae Man: Fukkatsu no Oshirimae Teikoku
synopsis: Maejiri, an otherwise ordinary office worker whose only unusual trait is that his butt is in the front, secretly lives a double life as the city's protector — Oshirimae Man. One day he discovers that a strange drug is spreading through the city which causes people's butts to move to the front. After infiltrating a pharmaceutical company, he uncovers the shocking "Oshirimae Man Empire Revival Plan," led by a mysterious villain burning with vengeance. Can Oshirimae Man stop him before all of humanity finds its butt… in the front? (Source: YouTube, edited)

title: Choujun! Choujou-senpai
synopsis: In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Choujou! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary! (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: Chu Wu
synopsis: People become ‘ghouls’ upon dying, and will enter the physical world through a door to cause chaos. Zhang Zha, a mere delivery boy, accidentally entered a haunted house, and resulted in a crisis— a ‘ghoul’ breakout. As such, people from all factions began to make an appearance in the story, while Zhang Zha continues to grow upon experiencing a series of adventures and fights with a mysterious scroll about modern Jianghu slowly unfolding alongside. (Source: MU)

title: Bai Lian Cheng Shen 3
synopsis: To resurrect his beloved Ning Yudie, Luo Zheng embarks on a heaven-defying path unlike any before. At the Tianyu Realm, he turns against Tianqiong, yet beneath the Shenqi Tower, they fight together. Through blurred lines of love and hatred, and trials that temper flesh and bone, he forges his path to divinity. Now, having ascended to the superior realm, Luo Zheng is determined to break the chains of fate and become the one truly free from destiny's grasp... But a deadly threat that exists beyond even heaven's will is now closing in. (Source: Youku)

title: Wuzhuang Fengbao
synopsis: The young human Wang Dong vowed to avenge his parents and joined the Storm Squad, determined to exterminate the Zhage insect species across the solar system. Through hardships, he awakened his Blade Warrior powers, upgraded his armor and skills, and ultimately uncovered the insects' ultimate plot on Earth along with his team. Facing overwhelming swarms, Wang activated his ultimate Blade Warrior form and defeated both human traitors and the insect leader Ying Yuan. (Source: Youku)

title: Da Zhou Zhen Hun Ren
synopsis: In order to resist the foreign evil organization that intends to destroy the Great Zhou Kingdom, the genius wizard Zuo Xiao gathered four sacred artifacts, practiced the five elements magic, protected the dragon veins of the Great Zhou Kingdom, and defeated the foreign evil forces one by one. (Source: Youku, Google translated)

title: Heiye Qishi
synopsis: In 2145, a century after the nuclear apocalypse triggered by the "New Human Project," which aimed to fully unleash humanity's potential, the surviving humans established a new social order on the wasteland. In this new world built upon technology, superpowers, and magic, Jiang Li, the only "complete New Human," awakens from hibernation and begins his legendary story. (Source: Youku, translated)

title: Dongda Gao Wu Xueyuan
synopsis: Orphan Qin Yu was specially admitted to the top cultivation academy, Dongda Martial Academy. Behind the city's calm, a demonic threat quietly approached. Qin Yu vowed to lead his fellow disciples to resist the invading demons. (Source: Youku)

title: Shanhai Jing Mima
title_english: Threads of Fate: A War Untold
synopsis: Shang prince Youshen Bupo rescued Jiang Li, disciple of Taiyi Sect, and the two of them traveled together, adventuring across the vast wilderness. They joined a merchant caravan, encountered heavenly tribulations, faced fierce beasts, defeated bandits, and rescued the heroine… Bound together by fate, the two became embroiled in a great war between the Xia and Shang dynasties. (Source: Youku)

title: Wan Ye Zhi Zhu
synopsis: Prince Ning Ming was chosen by a demon star and became the source of corruption in the world. To discover his origins and cleanse the corruption, he joined a secret agency. On his quest for the truth, the powerful Lord of the Ming granted Ning Ming extraordinary abilities, the supreme Emperor of the Zhou protected him, the daring Nightingale sisters favored him, and various prodigies willingly risked everything to help him cleanse the world of corruption. As he neared the truth, Ning Ming witnessed the world's cruelty and vowed to eliminate all corruption and save humanity. (Source: Youku)

title: Fan Ying
synopsis: The Pure Sea's currents flow from north to south, constantly flowing through this world. People build homes and thrive on the backs of giant beasts. Every wish has its response. The deity known as Fan Ying warns that only by letting your wishes run wild can you reap the rewards of miracles and survive. However, the unchanging rules are about to change, and those who transcend fate will eventually follow the origin of all things. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Sheng Xu
synopsis: The vast sea turns to dust, the thunder and lightning cease, and the mist approaches the earth once again. The shackles of the world are once again unlocked, and a brand new world unveils a mysterious corner... (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Wu Dong Qian Kun 7th Season
synopsis: Seventh season of Wu Dong Qian Kun.

title: Xingchen Bian 7th Season
synopsis: The descent of Mount Tianzun and the appearance of the Spiritual Treasure Cauldron ignited a frenzied struggle among the God-Kings for the "Azure Heaven Seal," the "Earth Seal," and the "Seal of Ten Thousand People." Qin Yu, a new father, is drawn into a conflict with powerful enemies like the Blood Sea Queen to save his brother Hou Fei. When Jiang Lan obtains the Earth Seal and becomes the target of everyone's anger, Qin Yu displays astonishing strength, intimidating the assembled heroes. However, the appearance of the Seal of Ten Thousand People brought even more brutal bloodshed. The Blood Sea Queen, disregarding the bloodshed of the God-Kings to seize the Seal of Ten Thousand People, Qin Yu, in a rage, slays powerful enemies to reclaim it. To end this conflict, he devises a scheme, luring those who coveted the seal into his mysterious domain, where he settles old scores. Ultimately, the three seals merge, and a new Heavenly Venerable is born. However, old grudges remain unresolved,

title: Quanzhi Fashi VII
synopsis: After the Flame Witch incident, Mo Fan returned to his training at the Magic City Academy, but at the most crucial moment, news suddenly arrived that his good friend Zhang Xiaohou had gone missing. The sentimental Mo Fan immediately halted his competition and, together with his vampire friend Liu Ru, rush to the ancient capital, venturing into the heart of the region where demons were active. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Quanzhi Fashi Tebie Pian: Beiyuan Weiji
title_english: The Almighty Mage SP: Beiyuan Crisis
synopsis: Mo Fan, Lingling, Zhao Manyan, and others come to Beiyuan to investigate the mysterious destruction of Beiyuan Village. During their investigation, they discover that it was the work of Leng Jue of the Black Church, who was parasitized by the Red Beast, who colluded with the evil forces of Nile. They also discover that there is an even bigger conspiracy behind them. When faced with the Red Beast's trap again, what actions will Mo Fan and his companions take? (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Lun Hui Leyuan
synopsis: Traversing countless worlds, reborn through endless quests, a blood-stained pact forged a night of beheadings. A merciless blade swept across the seven paradises, scattering countless heads and transforming the hunter Su Xiao into a terrifying symbol. Yet, even as killing became a daily routine, life and death a minor matter, he could not forget the death of his parents. The sinister smile of the gray gentleman beneath his hat, the eerie totems rising from corpses, and the oppressive might of the ancient god in the darkness gradually revealed the truth of that year. Chasing the true culprit, carrying on the legacy of the extermination of the law, and restoring balance to the elements became his inevitable destiny. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Shenhai Yujin
synopsis: Zhou Ming travels back in time and becomes Captain Duncan of the Lost Homeland, a terrifying evil god known as the Moving Scourge. In this deep-sea world created by an ancient god, the old order has been shattered, and isolated island cities are the only remaining lights of civilization. Yet, the shadows of the past lurk within the depths. Captain Duncan leads a diverse crew, delving into the perilous depths, and gradually begins to uncover history, glimpsing a glimpse of a despairing truth. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Wanmei Shijie Movie: Jiu Jie Fen Tian
synopsis: The story focuses on the final battle of the Immortal Ancient Era. The ancestral spirit, the Willow God, steps forward to lead the people in their search for hope. The Desolate Emperor, Shi Hao, uses a drop of his true blood to create a clone, reversing time and space to descend into the Immortal Ancient Era. In a shared struggle of life and death, he seeks the ultimate remedy to eradicate darkness. A great catastrophe of darkness descends, marking the tragic final chapter of the Immortal Ancient Era! (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Tunshi Xingkong Movie: Juezhan Yuanshi Xing
synopsis: During Luo Feng's training on the Primordial Star, he is faced with the covetousness and encirclement of the alien races. He uses his wisdom and strength to turn the tables and uphold the dignity of humanity. "I have a blade that can cleave the universe!" That breathtakingly beautiful battle blade accompanies Luo Feng as he slashes his way through the world! The Demon Race, the Mechanical Race, and the Insect Race reappear, forming a three-race alliance. The leaders of the three races, along with 6,000 Universe Venerables, besiege Luo Feng. Luo Feng unleashes the powerful force of "I Am the Universe" to annihilate them in one fell swoop. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Zhan Shen Movie: Cang Nan Zhi Shang
title_english: Slay the Gods Movie: The Dead of Cangnan
synopsis: After the release of the divine artifact Shiva's Wrath, Cangnan City faces an unprecedented crisis. With the Western evil gods lurking in their wake, are the Chinese gods about to awaken? Infused with the power of the twin gods, Lin Qiye joins the Night Watchmen of Cangnan City in fighting against the Western evil gods and defending Cangnan! The Second War of the Gods is about to begin! (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Jian Lai 2nd Season
synopsis: After the Li Zhu Grotto-Heaven collapses, Chen Ping’an takes on a great responsibility to escort Li Baoping and the others to Great Sui to study. Their journey is extremely dangerous, with enemies and supernatural threats along the way, but they receive help from the mysterious swordsman A Liang and other powerful figures. Traveling far and fighting countless battles, the young man grows stronger while learning the weight of responsibility. (Source: WeTV)

title: Douluo Dalu: 9528
synopsis: Tang San and Xiao Wu return to the Slaughter City, ravaged by the Blood Swan's Kiss. ​​They're hunted down by the mutated Slaughter King. A mysterious girl intervenes to save them, but a hidden agenda lies behind the scenes. Together, they'll uncover the truth behind the Slaughter City. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Lingjing Xingzhe
synopsis: The story features a distinct world setting, a diverse genre, and bizarre and treacherous spirit realm dungeons. The protagonist, Zhang Yuanqing, becomes a night-wandering deity thanks to a mysterious black card, only to be caught in a maelstrom of conspiracy pitting good against evil. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Xing Lu
synopsis: Under the grand strategy of interstellar travel, humanity has entered the space age, but simultaneously faces the threat of UMA, a high-dimensional extraterrestrial life form from Ganymede, a being capable of devouring human consciousness and evolving itself. Xu Xinghe, a bright student who should be pursuing higher education, witnesses his brother being devoured by the alien creature, awakens special abilities, and embarks on a journey to find his brother's consciousness and fight against UMA. Along the way, he partners with the mysterious girl Jiang Yao, and the fate of humanity and UMA is about to reach a major turning point. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Kaiju Jiu You Wangzhe Zhanghao
synopsis: In 2063, Earth enters the gaming era. Young Ye Hao awakens a legendary account, turning the tide for his family, defeating powerful monsters from another world, winning the heart of a young girl, and ultimately stopping a world-destroying conspiracy to protect his family. (Source: Yuewen YouTube Channel)

title: Zhi Jia Yi
synopsis: It tells the story of the heroine Tao Mengyan who returned to the mysterious village of Zangling in her dream to find the truth in order to resolve her nightmare. The village still retains the strange custom of worshiping "paper brides". Tao Mengyan, who was chosen as the "paper bride", experienced a life-and-death experience in Zangling Village, and finally solved the mystery of her past life and learned the thousand-year-old historical truth of the "Zangzun" belief in Zangling Village. (Source: Tencent, translated)
studios: Shou Fan Yu Shu Gongzuoshi | InfiniOrange Animation Studio | Origin

title: Xue Zhong Han Dao Xing
synopsis: After a three-year, six-thousand-mile odyssey, Xu Fengnian, the world's most dissolute playboy, returns to Beiliang. Facing his father, Xu Xiao, he realizes that the Northern Liang sword will ultimately be his own. This time, his servant, Old Huang, offers his life as a token of his loyalty, respectfully inviting the prince into the martial arts world. Xu Fengnian no longer hides his power, but boldly draws his sword, facing the dual threat of the imperial court and the martial arts world, realizing his master plan and gradually uncovering the truth behind his mother, Wu Su's, death. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Wangzhe Rongyao: Rongyao Zhi Zhang - Baozang Pian
synopsis: Bounty hunter Marco Polo wanders the Kingdom of Kings and happens to take in Luban No. 7, a mechanical manipulator separated from Master Luban. To retrieve the "Tuling Treasure Box" tucked away in Luban No. 7, Marco accompanies Luban No. 7 on a quest to find Master Luban's family. However, they fall prey to an enemy conspiracy. From the Cloud Desert to the underground city of Chang'an, the two, having forged a deep friendship, face even more formidable challenges together. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Dadao Zhishang
synopsis: It combines folklore, strange stories, cultivation system and suspense and conspiracy to construct a world where ghosts and gods are rampant and ancient and strange are intertwined. The work is characterized by the unique "oriental mystery". (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Qing Shan
synopsis: After being confined to Qingshan Mental Hospital, the gifted young man Chen Ji kills the enemy who killed his parents. He then accidentally travels back in time to the ancient world and becomes an apprentice at the Ning Dynasty Medical Clinic. Involved in a case involving the Secret Service, he becomes a non-staff member of the agency, only to discover he's also a spy for the enemy nation. The story revolves around this dual identity. Trapped in the maelstrom of power, Chen Ji secretly fights for survival, using modern knowledge to deconstruct spiritual cultivation systems and maneuvering to overturn the chessboard. Ultimately, he transforms from pawn to master, wielding the Qingshan Mountains as his blade, vowing to shatter the hypocrisy of heaven! (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Qing Jiao Wo Gui Chai Daren
synopsis: A perpetual night of catastrophe, terror descends, and strange phenomena abound! A young man, Wang Ye, is inexplicably chosen by the "Mysterious Post Office" to serve as a "ghost messenger," awakening his special powers and repeatedly embroiling himself in dangerous and paranormal phenomena. Witness how Wang Ye pushes the envelope, dispelling the mysteries and igniting the flames of humanity's survival amidst the terrifying darkness. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Shenmi Fusu
synopsis: "My name is Yang Jian, and by the time you read this, I'll be dead." Ordinary student Yang Jian is caught up in a bizarre invasion, acquiring parchment from the future and a mysterious eye, becoming a ghost wielder. Yang Jian and his classmates escape the campus, but the crisis is just beginning. In this sinister world, the human world is a prison. The price of peering into darkness is eternal loss amidst endless wonder. (Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Tiancai Julebu
synopsis: It uses a changing world line to make forward-looking reflections on the technological explosion, integrates intellectual games into urban legends, and opens up a new realm of "intellectual battle literature". (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Tian Wai Zhi Men
synopsis: The Tianyan Kingdom possesses twelve of the most powerful weapons in the world, known as the "Twelve Divine Cores." Bai Meng, a female soldier with exceptional strength, is exceptionally chosen to possess one of the Dragon-Patterned Divine Cores, but is treated as a mere ornament due to societal prejudice. Bai Meng is ordered to the Haiyue Kingdom to participate in a martial arts festival, hoping to prove herself, but unexpectedly becomes a murderer, and her Divine Core is "absorbed" and stolen by the local leader, Duan Tian! To clear her name and retrieve the Divine Core, Bai Meng engages in a battle of wits and courage with Duan Tian, ​​unfolding a series of thrilling life-or-death struggles, only to discover an even greater conspiracy hidden behind it all… In this treacherous world, who is the pawn, and who is the player? When survival hangs in the balance, where will their differing beliefs lead them? (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Yowaki Max Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
synopsis: I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game. After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum, and then become a curator. So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son. But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily? (Source: MU)

title: Rakugaki
synopsis: The moment the first gleam of sunlight trickled in gently stirring the folds of a shallow sleep—that was when the graffiti appeared... (Source: Official Site)

title: Yi Wanjia Zhi Ming
synopsis: In the city, people lived under the protection of a barrier, enjoying a peaceful life. Secretly, the Fortune Star agents of the Sword Bureau had been battling the calamity creatures for decades. When Fortune Star agents were kidnapped, the creatures swarmed the city, bringing devastation. The reclusive youth Chen Kefan, competing in an e-sports tournament, encountered an invasion of bloodblade bugs and witnessed the killer of his parents reappear. In the desperate fight, his latent Fortune Star power awakened, setting him on a path of revenge. Yet, as he and his comrades fought bloodily and risked their lives, they discovered that the apocalypse was merely a game played by the gods. (Source: Youku)

title: Jipin Tian Shi
synopsis: The hero, gifted with extraordinary abilities and from a powerful Daoist sect, left his sect at his master's invitation to exorcise ghosts. After clearing two haunted houses, he became entangled in a series of bizarre events while facing challenges from various factions: he clashed with a Thai sorcerer, dealt a crushing blow to Japanese Onmyoji, fended off a Korean witch's challenge, and humiliated Western exorcists—defeating and banishing masters from across the world. In a realm where technology intertwined with the supernatural, he slayed demons and spirits, growing into a legendary Celestial Master. (Source: Youku)

title: Jinji Xingzhe
synopsis: On the world's dark edge, forbidden powers are growing. When high schooler Yan Feng is drawn into a deadly incident, he joins a secret organization to save his sister, contain sinister artifacts, and battle villains bent on unleashing these powers. As the fight intensifies, he begins to uncover the truth about his own origins. (Source: Youku)

title: 134 Yi Wang Ju
synopsis: At the start of the new year, college student Chu Lan's ordinary life ended abruptly. With his loved ones dead and a demon possessing him, he was drawn into a thousand-year struggle of fate. He became both the "only key" to end the disaster and the "vessel of evil" that could destroy humanity. Forced by destiny, he joined a secret agency to break the endless cycle of the Spirit Calamity. Ultimately, he faced a choice at the end of the battle between good and evil. (Source: Youku)

title: Tianmu
synopsis: The young Han Jin bore a future Dao embryo, wielded mystical powers, defeated nine dark realms, and overcame inner demons, forging a path to save humanity and defy fate. (Source: Youku)

title: Hai Ru Shenming
synopsis: A tech giant corporation discovered an ancient time rift connecting higher-dimensional space. To monopolize energy, the tech giant concealed this discovery from the world. Its relentless exploitation eventually caused the temporal rift to go out of control, allowing non-Earthly spiritual energy to spread across the globe. Capitalizing on this upheaval, the giant accelerated its monopoly over the world. Gradually, more and more heroes capable of forging contracts with deities through spiritual energy united to oppose the evil forces intent on destroying humanity. (Source: Youku)

title: Tuer Ni Wudile Xiashan Qu Ba
synopsis: The Ye family was suddenly massacred—Ye Beichen's parents and brothers were slaughtered, and he himself was ruthlessly thrown into the moat, clinging to life by a thread. Rescued by his senior sister, he was taken to Kunlun Mountain, where he spent five grueling years mastering martial arts. Five years later, he returned in full force, armed with the peerless skills taught by 99 invincible masters. Back in the mortal world, when faced with old enemies and powerful factions, Ye Beichen showed no fear. With extraordinary martial prowess and overwhelming strength, he unleashed chaos across the city, carving a path of revenge and dominance—turning the tables and crushing all who once sought his downfall. (Source: Youku)

title: Shang Cheng Zhixia
synopsis: The inhabitants of the Upper City live in luxury high above the clouds, while those of the Lower City struggle to survive in a wasteland overrun by monstrous beasts and shrouded in poisonous miasma. Ning Fan, a poor student from the Lower City, becomes a wanderer who takes on high-risk jobs to earn money in order to save his mother. From then on, he steps into an endless killing field, leading his team to defy fate and ultimately shatter the heavenly ladder, determined to burn away the cage of destiny with a prairie fire. (Source: Youku, translated)

title: Yi Zhan Cangqiong
synopsis: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens. (Source: Youku)

title: Kai (ONA)
synopsis: In an out-of-control world, survivors faced a thrilling and perilous apocalyptic battlefield. (Source: Youku)

title: Ye Bu Shou
synopsis: 2283, in a post-nuclear wasteland, Fortress City 021 was controlled by Ark Corporation. Their so-called "Savior Guardians" appeared to protect humanity but secretly conducted human experiments using X chips and manipulated public opinion. Young Han Che witnessed his brother's murder by the false Guardians and unexpectedly awakened the "1307 Source System" within him, gaining superpowers. He joined the Yebushou organization, rebuilt by Guan Shanhu, and fought alongside hacker Tian Xin and engineer Kang Di. Yebushou infiltrated Ark training camps and Ghost Island Prison, exposing a plot to create a superpowered army using experiments and mutants. As Han Che unlocked new abilities and faced formidable enemies like Emperor Angel and Divine-Eye Immortal, he embarked on a path of vengeance, truth, and salvation. However, the hidden AI "Lefu" was plotting to control all human consciousness. (Source: Youku)

title: Shi Ren Huixiang
synopsis: Lu Xiaobai, an ordinary high schooler, is suddenly attacked by "Xiao", a higher-dimensional envoy. On the brink of death, he awakens time-based powers and is rescued by his future self, "Cang". Taking up his late father's mission, Lu Xiaobai takes over the leadership of the Bureau of Demon Defense, an organization dedicated to defending humanity. Together with Cang and new allies, he confronts a series of crises sparked by villains, ultimately drawing out and defeating them, reshaping the timeline, and saving humanity from a doomed future. (Source: Youku)

title: Bai Gui Ri Xing
synopsis: A parasitized boy killed his cruel master and became the strongest supernatural hunter. Using his bizarre form, he hunted the mysterious, ultimately transforming into a "Mad Killing God," saving humanity at the cost of everything he cherished. (Source: Youku)

title: Tian Guan Xueyuan
synopsis: To resist invasions from other worlds, the Heavenly Great Sage founded Tianguan Academy. Every year, the Academy would recruit new students—but in the end, only nine could become the official Heavenly Officers. Gu Tian, a young soccer player, accidentally awakened his hidden power while saving someone on the field. Invited by his senior Xia Zhi, he boarded Subway Line 36 to Tianguan Academy. With the world's finest teachers, strict assessments, and a brutal elimination system, the Academy pushes its students to the limit. By a stroke of fortune, Gu Tian became the 81st student to pass the entrance trial. Under the guidance of celestial masters, he studied spells and divine decrees, honed his combat skills against powerful rivals, and strode forward step by step toward the ultimate goal of becoming one of the Nines. (Source: Youku)

title: Yi Ci Guiling
synopsis: Xu Yichuan accidentally travels into a nightmarish realm and awakens the ability to regenerate. To escape this twisted dimension and return to his family, he gathers a group of partners to brave deadly games and unlock abilities. But it turns out that all this is a death trap conspired by the realm's supreme overseer. In the end, Xu Yichuan and his companions manage to break through the overseer’s grip and keep looking for ways to escape. (Source: Youku)

title: Suo Yao Lu
synopsis: College student Liu Ye accidentally entered a mysterious pawnshop, awakened his bloodline powers, and inherited the Mountain-Seeking Map. In rescuing a friend, he unlocked the map's mysterious spells, gradually sensing ties from his past life with Bai Ze. The unusual abilities of Liu Ye drew the attention of the Supernatural Bureau, which sent the elite Lu Li to intervene under the pretext of "supervision." At the same time, the pawnshop heiress Lin Nianyu began pursuing him to seize the map, and the three formed separate demon-sealing teams with their own agendas. (Source: Youku)

title: Chaoxinxing
synopsis: The hero of the Star Federation, "Beidou", was framed as a traitor and imprisoned. A decade later, Yang Bei returned to clear his name, embarking on an adventure with the Federation President's daughter to find allies. Ultimately, Yang Bei exposed the conspiracy and reclaimed his status as a star hero. (Source: Youku)

title: Xibu de Tuke
synopsis: Tuke is a spirit guardian exiled to the mortal realm. For centuries, he's protected humanity with eight other spirit guardians. But the River God's Son, who was sealed away by them, breaks free and takes control of seven spirit guardians' souls, plotting to transform the world into a purgatory. To save his friends and defeat the River God's Son, Tuke ventures all the way to the Son's stronghold, where an epic battle ensues... (Source: Youku)

title: Shi Yiren

Each with an eccentric personality and a knack for chaos, they've earned a reputation as the infamous "Kimen-gumi." One day, new transfer student Yui Kawa and her friend Chie Uru encounter the group and soon find themselves drawn into their antics. Around them are other colorful cliques—from the handsome "Iro Otoko-gumi" led by Shou Kireide, to the delinquent "Ban-gumi" led by You Nihiruda, the athletic "Ude-gumi" led by Kai Undou, and the tough girl squad "Onna-gumi" led by Jako Amano. As time passes and a new spring begins, the everyday lives of these eccentric students unfold in a lively and comedic school story. (Source: MAL News)

The incident was brought to an end by Tekkadan, a group of boys who came from Mars. News of Tekkadan's exploits has also reached the ears of Wistario Afam, a youth born and raised at the Radonitsa Colony near Venus. Venus, which lost to Mars in the contest for development, is a remote frontier planet in which the four great economic blocs show little interest. It is now used only as a penal colony for criminals, whose inhabitants don't even have IDs. Then Wistario, who hopes to change the status quo of this homeland, encounters a girl who claims to be the guide to the Urdr-Hunt. (Source: Gundam Global Portal)

It only happens when Meishi, the detective she works with, is around... So, she makes a choice...? (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

An another world adventure tale of miraculous reversal cheats burst forth! (Source: AlphaPolis)

title: Ghost Concert: Missing Songs
synopsis: In the year 2045, singing has been forbidden. Music is no longer created or performed by humans; instead, a music application called MiucS produces all songs on their behalf. One day, a girl named Seria Aiba hears a human singing voice while out with her friends—something that should no longer exist. Following the sound, she encounters a mysterious presence: a ghost. What appears before her is not an ordinary spirit, but a figure from beyond this world known as a Great Ghost. As Seria becomes drawn into encounters involving Great Ghosts, the psychic organization TERA, and a strange song known as the Possession Requiem, she finds herself stepping into a hidden side of a world that has erased human music. This is the story of how Seria's life begins to change—and the path that leads her toward becoming a ghost herself. (Source: MAL News)

title: Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku: Eureka Evrika
synopsis: In an alternate version of the early 20th century where technological progress evolved along a different path shaped by steam power, Kyoto is blanketed in constant smoke. A boy, hardened by the loss of his brother, grows distrustful after their shared dream of an "Age of Electricity" is cut short. A deeply devout girl hides her dreams and regrets for her deceased mother deep within her heart. When the two cross paths, they set about exploring the secrets of the 20th Century Electrical Catalog, a glimpse into the future they long for. Together, they must confront their pasts and carve a path toward the future they once believed in. (Source: Press Release)

synopsis: Nori Kamitsuki has recently moved to the Gunma prefecture from Chiba, following after Otoya Todoroki, a former friend who moved there in elementary school. While on the way there, he receives an ominous text message from Todoroki telling him to turn back and that once someone enters Gunma, they never return. Ignoring the message, As Kamitsuki goes about his school life and makes new friends. These people make it their mission to prove any negative stereotypes surrounding Gunma wrong and show Kamitsuki all the ways Gunma is different from the rest of Japan—from its local foods and landmarks, the changes to its daily school life, and even the attitude of the people who live there. Gunma is widely regarded as the least popular prefecture in Japan, but they clearly don't know Gunma yet! [Written by MAL Rewrite]

Right here and now, the curtains rises on the Unit Cup! (Source: All Aikatsu! Wiki)

synopsis: A high school boy, Itsuki Tomonari, gets involved in a kidnapping and ends up taking care of Hinako Konohana, a young lady from one of Japan's largest conglomerates. On the surface, Hinako seems to be a brilliant and charming girl, but in reality, she is a lazy girl with no life skills. However, due to family reasons, Hinako has to play the role of the "perfect young lady" at school. Wanting to protect her, Itsuki takes care of her in a very caring manner. Eventually, Hinako begins to fawn on Itsuki with all her might... "Now... if Itsuki isn't around, I would hate it." This is a love story that begins with a cute young lady with a gap that transcends the master-servant relationship. (Source: Hobby Japan, translated)

synopsis: Maria, the daughter of a duke, grew up believing she would one day inherit her father's dukedom. Accordingly, she focused her attentions on honing her martial arts prowess, while thoughts of marriage fell by the wayside. But the arrival of a baby brother in her family means she's losing her role as heir! Now that she's decided it's time to marry after all, she's arrived a little late to the game! Are there even any eligible bachelors left? Upon going to study abroad in a neighboring country where she might still stand a chance at getting hitched, she's bewildered when the crown prince there declares before all that his engagement to her is null and void! Wait... what engagement?! Apparently, he's mistaken her for the wrong girl! But once that's all cleared up and he catches sight of her knocking out a whole pack of bandits, it turns out that this prince may have a thing for ass-kicking young ladies after all. (Source: Square Enix)

title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
synopsis: Tsukuyomi is a virtual realm where hopes and dreams come together. Iroha Sakayori, a 17-year-old high school student in Tokyo, leads an extremely busy life trying to balance part-time work and academics. She finds peace by watching a popular streamer named Yachiyo Runami, who is the administrator of an online virtual space called Tsukuyomi. Iroha frequents Tsukuyomi, where people can live different lives and freely pursue their creativity, and she passes the time by supporting Yachiyo and playing battle games to earn a little extra money. On her way home one day, Iroha finds a telephone pole shining with iridescent hues. To her surprise, an adorable baby emerges from the pole. Unable to abandon it, Iroha takes the infant home and watches her rapidly grow into a girl her own age. "Are you Princess Kaguya?" The grown-up Kaguya develops a self-indulgent personality. Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious...until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

When Anna, as a witch, displays her magical skills, Roland realizes that magic can replace some modern technology, so he formulates a "great development of magical industry" plan. title: Death Stranding: Isolation
synopsis: Once, there was an explosion... Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink, a legendary porter sets out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved. Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the others are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting. A boy with a grudge against Bridges. A girl who embraces lonelin

title: Kyoukai no Melody
synopsis: After losing his musical partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, Kyousuke has distanced himself from music and lives without motivation. Three years later, Kai suddenly appears before Kyousuke, unchanged and as outspoken as ever. "Being alive but doing nothing... that's no different from being dead." Encouraged by Kai's words, Kyousuke returns to the world of music, rediscovering the joy of creating sound together. But their time together cannot last forever... (Source: MAL News)

title_english: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
synopsis: On an April night in Tokyo, still too early for fireworks, university student Kakeru Mano meets a woman named Koharu Fuyutsuki. She is a beautiful girl who stands out from the crowd, laughs a lot, and exudes a warmth that contrasts sharply with Kakeru's own introversion. But there was something Kakeru didn't know at first—she can't see. Unlike Kakeru, Koharu hasn't given up on anything, even with her blindness. She attends university daily, shows interest in clubs, makes friends—and dreams of launching fireworks one day. Kakeru wonders why, when she can't see them...but maybe it doesn't matter. And maybe he can start moving forward, too, for the girl who's always been by his side. (Source: Yen Press)

title: Loca!
synopsis: Two inquisitive kids, Tamo and Haru, might be the last people on Earth. They explore the silent, overgrown ruins of what was once rural Japan, documenting their discoveries in a notebook. When they come across a disused commuter train, and find out that it's operational, who knows where it will take them? A disconcertingly cheerful and childish interpretation of the end of the world. (Source: fantasiafestival.com)

title: Di Yi Xulie 2
synopsis: Nuclear winter has arrived, civilization has collapsed, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. Species mutations and scarce resources create an unpredictable future and environment, leading to a series of crises. To protect themselves, humanity has built walls, but outside these walls, survival depends on blood and fire. The protagonist, Ren Xiaosu, and his younger brother, Yan Liuyuan, are among them. They were just ordinary teenagers in the wilderness, without shelter or a way out; their only support was each other. But fate granted them the power to awaken in their dire circumstances. The Jingshan earthquake caused the collapse of Wall 113, fully shattering the post-apocalyptic chaos. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescued Luo Lan, the military leader, and entered Wall 109. A new life was about to begin, but the real test had only just begun… (Source: Bilibili, translated)

synopsis: In 193 AD, Guo Jia presented the dark military strategy of "slaughtering one city to subdue ten," leading Cao Cao to attack Xuzhou under the pretext of "avenging his father." Historical records state that "hundreds of thousands of men and women were killed." Liaoyuan Huo, posing as Zhao Yun, aided the people of Xuzhou in their desperate defense, outwitting and outmaneuvering Cao Cao's army, while secretly recruiting Liu Bei to join the fight against Cao Cao. Lu Bu, lying in wait in Chenliu, launched a surprise attack on Cao Cao's rear, following the advice of his strategist Chen Gong. Zhuge Liang and Sima Yi also arrived in Xuzhou, stirring up the war. The Battle of Xuzhou saw Lu Bu, Xu Chu, Dian Wei, Zhao Yun, and other powerful figures engage in a fierce battle that shook the world. After this battle, the tables have turned in Xuzhou. title: Jiaonang Jihua: Qiji
synopsis: "Capsules Project" is a collection of domestically produced animated short films created by a professional team with mature animation production experience. With the creative theme of "extreme emotion + independent theme," it does not restrict the creative form, exploring the possibilities of animation together with the team. The aim is to collaboratively create original short films with diverse styles and characteristics, and to help Chinese animators reach the world stage. "Miracle" represents transcending conventions and breaking through limitations to achieve extraordinary success, often accompanied by a sense of mystery that inspires awe and curiosity. What miracles will occur in these 10 stories? (Source: Bilibili, translated)

A wandering swordsman named Shao Xia, an amnesiac pharmacist named Wuming, a passionate constable named Susu, and a royal pharmacist named Xu Changqing form an alliance while searching for a mysterious monster. They gradually uncover the dark truth behind the city. The group must choose between trust and betrayal, power and consequences, attempting to save themselves and others in this unbalanced world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Shang Shan
synopsis: A Taoist priest, while tracking a demon, inadvertently discovered that a little girl in a certain family had been raised by the demon. She had consumed demon cores since childhood, altering her constitution, and the demon, due to a heavenly tribulation, could no longer care for her. The priest took the girl as his disciple, giving her the Taoist name Shang Shan, and the two began their journey through the human world, vanquishing demons and exorcising evil spirits. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Xian Jian Qi Xia Zhuan Si
synopsis: For the sake of their cultivation endeavors, the Qionghua Sect sent its elders to forge two swords, Wangshu and Xihe, and sought two disciples to wield them in dual cultivation, attempting to bind the demon realm and seize its immense spiritual power. This ultimately triggered a great war between humans and demons, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides. During this time, Su Yu, the host of Wangshu, disagreed with the Qionghua Sect's cultivation philosophy and left the sect with Yun Tianqing. The demon realm seized the opportunity to escape, and the Qionghua Sect's leader perished in the war. The two married on Qingluan Peak and had a son, Yun Tianhe. They both died young due to the icy cold that invaded their bodies. Young Yun Tianhe grew up alone on Qingluan Mountain. He was unaware of his parents' past, and the unexpected arrival of Han Lingsha set the wheels of fate turning once more. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

She becomes a fifth-class citizen, the lowest rank in the world, forced to make a living by "scavenging garbage." However, she discovers the strangeness and danger of this world in her work: various bizarre polluting monsters, the world's strange operating rules, and even her own strange self… Zhu Ning gradually uncovers a huge secret hidden behind the world, which also brings her immense danger. In this unknown post-apocalyptic world, Zhu Ning is forced into complex conflicts, searching for the truth about herself and the world. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

In his reincarnation, he was named Li Yunxiao, a 15-year-old boy from the Tianshui Kingdom and the eldest grandson of the Li family of the Marshal's Mansion. At this time, Tianshui was beset by powerful enemies invading from the outside and princes vying for the throne from within, making the Li family, who held military power, the center of a vortex of crisis. I will take my revenge! Wait, you mean the soul in front of me with only 100 days left to live is the real "Lie"? Alright, alright! 100 days—let's both be crowned kings together! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Zhen Hun Jie 5th Season
synopsis: The world of Rakshasa Street is engulfed in conflict, with various forces stirring with ambition. The united forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu, are unstoppable, the Hall of Heroes suffers a devastating blow, and the Spirit Realm's rule is on the verge of collapse. Countless heroes are emerging, and a new crisis is about to erupt due to the ambitions of the Kingdom Organization. In the world of Rakshasa Street, no one dares to say "no!" Cao Yanbing's path to becoming king has officially begun! (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Inaka Hoshi
synopsis: In the year 20XX, space development had progressed beyond the present day, and humanity had expanded its living spaces across many planets. On the far edge of the galaxy lies the Countryside Planet, home to Moyori Obayashi, a first-year high school student who enjoys collecting scraps and discarded things, and her friend Kayo Daijamori, a girl who dreams of magic and loves to imagine other worlds. This is the story of a mysterious summer day they share. Set in a society increasingly focused on standardizing and controlling people, the story asks how the overlooked, undefined spaces—those pushed out of view—may hold something essential for preserving our humanity and the freedom to be ourselves. (Source: Indie-AniFest)

title: Mata Korosarete Shimatta no desu ne, Tantei-sama
synopsis: Sakuya Otsuki is the son of a legendary detective, working to follow in his father's footsteps with his assistant, Lilithea. However, something's different about this high-school sleuth. Wherever he goes, he always manages to get himself entangled in his cases—as a murder victim! When Sakuya is tasked to infiltrate a luxury cruise ship, he finds himself killed once again. But every time he reopens his eyes, Lilithea is there by his side, ready to help him get to the bottom of the mystery... (Source: Yen Press)

title: Wareware wa Uchuujin

Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart. Spanning more than thirty years, this gentle, contemplative story invites the audience to reflect on the meaning of life through the paths their lives take. (Source: Nothing New)

title: Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi ni Deta Tensei Elf, Moteamashita Jumyou de Ikeru Densetsu to Naru
synopsis: Minoru Kido, age 30, cause of death: traffic accident. As a Japanese, I died without leaving any evidence of my life. At the time of my death, I was thinking, "Next time, I want to live a long life and leave behind some proof of my life," when I was reincarnated as an elf with a life span of 1,000 years! That's why I made a vow. I vowed that this time I would spend my whole life living in a way that would leave a mark on my life. At the age of 20, I was able to use all of the healing magic that elves were originally equipped with at will. By the age of 30, I had mastered all attribute magic, and by the age of 100, I had deciphered all the ancient magic formulas. For the remaining 900 years of my life, all I have to do is run out of the Elven forest and become a warrior. One day, I'll be missed by a fledgling adventurer who will eventually be called a hero. title: Kami no Shizuku
synopsis: Shizuku Kanzaki is the only son of world-renowned wine critic Yutaka Kanzaki. From a young age, Shizuku has been subjected to strange education from his father all for the sake of wine. From learning to gracefully decant a drink to intently remembering the smell of leather belts and pencils, the training causes him to grow resentful of everything related to wine. Discontent with his father, he leaves home to become an average sales representative for a beer company, refusing to ever touch wine again. When his father suddenly passes away, Shizuku finds himself being dragged back into the world he hates so much. As part of his father's will, the one who will inherit his prized wine collection and estate will be the person who can correctly identify the "12 Apostles" of wines as well as the legendary "Drops of God." In order to inherit the assets, Shizuku has one year to complete the task, but he finds the proposition ridiculous when he is the only living relative of Yutaka. What Yutaka

title: Marika-chan no Koukando wa Bukkowareteiru
synopsis: Confessing to my childhood friend Marika was impossible for someone as unpopular as me. So, I did what any desperate boy would do—I wished upon a shooting star! When I woke up, that dream had come true?! I could see a love meter for people, just like in a love simulation game. Once I realized this was real and not a dream I went straight to see Marika. Her love meter was so low it had broken and practically fallen all the way to hell! If she hated me so much why was she so nice?! Is this how she really felt or...?! (Source: Coolmic)

When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Hua Jianghu: Bu Liang Ren Ba

Faced with the sudden changes at Huan Yin Fang and the many mysteries surrounding Ji Ruxue, how will he break through the predicament? In this world, grudges are easily settled, but the boat of the heart is hard to cross. Crisis resurfaces in the Central Plains; let's see how Bu Liang Ren once again quell the turmoil! (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Shaonian Ge Xing: Nanming Li Huo
synopsis: After the Heaven-Splitting Sword was drawn, the divine weapons scattered across the land began to show unusual signs. Xiao Se, together with several sworn friends from the jianghu, set out to seek the divine weapons and save the world. (Source: Youku)

title: Sanxian Lun Hui
synopsis: Where the Yellow, Yangtze, and Lancang Rivers begin as one, dwell the three "Water Ghost" clans, the Ding, Jiang, and Yi, along their banks. What are Water Ghosts? Beings who move through water as they please, masters of geomancy and treasure hunting. Yi Sa, the last of her line, runs an "underwater bank" along the Lancang. During a perilous "Golden Soup" dive, she rescues Zong Hang. Seeking truth and a cure for her own fate, Yi Sa trains him as a Water Ghost. Together with Ding Yu Die of the Ding clan, the trio descends into the primordial "Ancestral Golden Soup." (Source: WeTV)

title: Long Hun
synopsis: For millennia, the ancient and mysterious Dragon Clan has thrived on the Central Continent. Yet the struggle between the Light and Dark Souls of the Divine Realm drags the dragons into conflict. The clan is torn apart by brutal civil strife, facing the threat of extinction. In this desperate hour, Ao Xue, the long-absent prince of the East Sea, returns with formidable power, determined to save the Dragon Clan from peril. (Source: WeTV)

title: Tadaima, Ojamasaremasu!
synopsis: So is this what it means to have roommates now?! Office worker Rinko, 24, lives alone and is secretly an otaku. One day, her apartment gets connected to the two neighboring rooms through a "hole" in the wall. In the room on the left is a fresh-faced yet mysterious guy who is overly-sweet to Rinko. The room on the right is occupied by a guy with violent tendencies who is similarly mysterious... But wait! "I... I think I know him!" Rinko's only source of solitude, her apartment, has been turned upside down. Now, every day is full of heart-pounding surprises! (Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Girl Crush
synopsis: Tenka Momose, a high school freshman that can sing and dance... she's pretty and smart to boot! She's good at everything but love. One day she meets Erian Satou, and was pulled in by her passionate dedication to becoming an idol. This is the story about two young girls chasing after their K-Pop idol dream!! (Source: Comikey Media)

title: Prism Rondo
synopsis: In early-1900s London, Lili Ichijouin, a Japanese exchange student travels to England to enroll in the prestigious Saint Thomas Art Academy. Determined to become a painter, she arrives under pressure: her parents expect her to rise to the top of her class within six months or return home. Lili's drive intensifies when she encounters Kit Church, a gifted aristocratic student known for his talent and detachment. While Kit has devoted himself entirely to painting, Lili's sincerity and resilience begin to shift something in him. The two share little beyond their love for art, yet their relationship quickly becomes central to life at the academy. (Source: Netflix, edited)

title: Quanneng Gaoshou
synopsis: "I came from the wilderness, raised by five incredibly powerful grandparents. To uncover the truth behind my parents' murder, I return to the city." Watch as this young hero, skilled in martial arts, music, chess, medicine, and cooking, feigns weakness to outsmart others, surrounded by beautiful women, rises against all odds, solves a shocking mystery, and vows to become the city's all-around master, the undisputed ruler of this land! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Meitantei Precure!
synopsis: Anna Akechi is a second-year junior high student living in Makoto Mirai Town. On her 14th birthday, she has a chance encounter with a fairy named Pochitan, and a magical pendant caused her to travel back in time from 2027 to 1999! In the Makoto Mirai Town 28 years in the past, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, a girl her age who wants to become a great detective. Meanwhile, people in town are in trouble as their prized possessions are being stolen from under their noses - the cause being a group of Phantom Thieves. To stop them, Anna and Mikuru turn into Precures! Maybe if they solve these mysteries, Anna can find her way back to her own time? (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Demons' Crest
synopsis: Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she's since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game's horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same...and staying alive is just the beginning! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Yoroi Shin Den Samurai Troopers Part 2

title: Kyoufu Collector
synopsis: The internet is full of creepypastas, cryptid sightings, tales of paranormal activity, and unsolved disappearances. These are mostly rumors and pranks fueled by trolls—entertainment. But the unlucky few learn the hard way that some legends are true. Many of these unfortunate souls are doomed, but their luck may change if they cross paths with the boy in the red hood. He roams from town to town and appears wherever strange things occur. Is he a light in the dark? Or living proof that monsters are all too real...? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Uchi no Otouto-domo ga Sumimasen
synopsis: During spring break at the end of her first year of high school, Ito learns she has to move because her mother is getting remarried. What she didn't expect is suddenly gaining four younger stepbrothers under the same roof. Determined to get along with her new family, Ito does her best to adjust, but the eldest brother, Gen, is distant and hard to read. Yet as they spend more time together, she starts to see glimpses of kindness behind his cool exterior. (Source: MAL News)

title: Xian Jian Qi Xia Zhuan San
synopsis: A thousand years ago, the divine general Fei Peng and the Demon Sovereign Chong Lou engaged in a fierce battle in the New Immortal Realm. The divine sword "Zhao Dan" fell to the mortal world, and Fei Peng was demoted to earth. A millennium later, the Lock Demon Tower of Shu Mountain trembled, and Fei Peng's reincarnation, Jing Tian, who obtained the demonic sword, embarked on an adventure alongside Tang Xuejian, Xu Changqing, and Zi Xuan to collect the Five Spirit Orbs and seal the Lock Demon Tower. (Source: WeTV)

title: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru
synopsis: The series follows Henri Cleats, an adventurer who only has a single skill: Evasion. Wanting to take care of his sickly younger sister Colette, he joins a party. However, due to weak attack power and lack of skills, he is expelled from this party. However, it turns out that his evasion skill comes with a bonus: he is able to pass through walls and reach the end of dungeons without defeating the boss. Thus, he is able to claim a dungeon's First Clear bonus more than once. With his newfound knowledge, Henri sets out to clear as many dungeons as he can while also leveling up his power. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Reiwa no Dara-san
synopsis: Clouds blacken the sky and sheets of rain turn the mountain forest into a treacherous maze... A landslide crushes a razor wire fence, and buries a "NO TRESPASSING" sign... Two young siblings wander into a dark world where they do not belong, and a long, horrid shadow rears up to meet them—Anyway, so that's how we met Dara-san! She might look kinda scary, but just wait until you get to know her! "Look, I'm a god of misfortune, okay!? Aren't you kids gonna freak out about my grotesque visage!?" (Source: Yen Press)

title: Xin Baoxiao Xiaoyuan
synopsis: It tells the story of the protagonist, Daitou, who comes to the city from a village called Baichi Village to study and work. He meets various classmates and friends such as Wangcai, Xiaoyin, Nuomi Tuan, and Gao Chaisheng, and they share their hilarious daily life of studying and living together. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Psyren
synopsis: Ageha Yoshina is a self-confident high school student who helps others for a fee. On his way back from a job, he finds a strange calling card with the word "Psyren" imprinted left behind in a phone booth and decides to keep it, unaware of its purpose. The very next day, Ageha discovers that his classmate Sakurako Amamiya has the exact same calling card in her possession. When he questions her, Sakurako asks him to save her, signaling the day his troubles begin. Confused by the circumstances of this encounter, Ageha realizes something is wrong when Sakurako goes missing. In an attempt to figure out what is happening, he decides to call the number provided on the calling card and is asked a series of questions by a mysterious voice, ending with a final, cryptic question: "Would you like to go to Psyren?" Thus begins two teenagers' participation in a game of life or death within a strange world inhabited by monsters called Taboo. Granted the ability to use psychic powers known as PSI, th

While Kiriko believes that food should be made with the customer in mind, Jan believes that cooking should be used for competition. (Source: ANN)

title: Otome Kaijuu Caraméliser
synopsis: Kuroe Akaishi is an introverted, quiet, and seemingly normal high school girl. Though accustomed to being alone, her dreary days begin to change when she meets Arata Minami, a bright and handsome boy in her class. Despite his popular status, he is kind enough to reach out to an outcast like her; soon, Kuroe finds her heart begins to pound around him. It keeps pounding and pounding and pounding until Kuroe transforms into a monstrous kaijuu! She has a certain affliction: as her embarrassment grows, so do the monstrous appendages from her body; and when it hits a peak, she unleashes the full extent of her transformation. At the same time, beauty meets the kaijuu, and Japan faces off against the looming threat of the mysterious monster. Can Minami accept her feelings, or will he too be frightened off by her colossal form? Depending on his decision, the world may experience the full devastation of a girl's heart-pumping, youthful love. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mofusand
synopsis: Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit. A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace, but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow — is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures. A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea, steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes, the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall… These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight. You can’t help but smile and think, “So true!” A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments. (Source: QTORY YouTube channel)

Faced with the eventual outbreak of a common crisis, everyone, for the safety of Chang'an, overcomes all difficulties and works together to defeat the mechanical monsters, restoring peace to Chang'an. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Jirai nan desu ka? Chihara-san
title_english: Are You a Jirai Girl, Chihara-san?
synopsis: It's the start of a new semester, and high school junior Kuroki finds himself seated beside the girl everyone whispers about: Mai Chihara. With her gothic fashion, jet-black hair, and intense stare, Chihara is said to be a "landmine" girl or jirai-kei, the hyper-feminine, dark aesthetic often associated with yandere tendencies and unstable personalities. But when Kuroki accidentally draws Chihara's attention, he discovers she isn't nearly as unstable as people claim. Beneath the intimidating aura is a surprisingly sweet girl... if a little weird. Hesitantly, Kuroki begins to learn more about Chihara and her strange quirks. Is there more to her than her volatile reputation? Or is all the dark clothing just a red flag in disguise? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

We hope this animation will light a small flame in your heart.'' (Source: Official Youtube, translated)

title: Ruri Dragon
synopsis: Ruri Aoki is just another average high school student—until she wakes one morning to discover horns growing out of her head. Confused and unimpressed by the change, she shows them to her mother. However, her mother remains unfazed and reveals a shocking truth: Ruri is half-dragon! Although Ruri has no idea what to make of this sudden development, she decides to go to school like normal, hoping that another ordinary day awaits her. But it does not take long before her best friend, classmates, and homeroom teacher all notice something amiss. Swarmed by people requesting to look at, feel, and take selfies with her horns, Ruri realizes being a half-dragon is going to be much more chaotic than she expected. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Historie
synopsis: Alexander the Great is a name known around the world as belonging to one of the greatest military commanders in history. But due to the grandeur of his name and enormity of his achievements, his right-hand man Eumenes remains a lesser-known historical figure. Eumenes led a turbulent life, overcoming numerous struggles and traveling great distances to meet and befriend many of the most influential names of his time. One does not become the right hand of Alexander the Great by mere birth. Eumenes fought for his position with fierce talent, intellect, and confidence. This is his story. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

On top of that, he was kicked out of the hero party, and eventually had his adventurer's license revoked... And that's how he ended up a vagabond, wandering aimlessly. After an encounter with Rabi, a cursed little girl, a new adventure begins... (Source: Square Enix)

title: King of Kings
synopsis: Renowned storyteller Charles Dickens finds it challenging to bond with his imaginative son, Walter, amidst his busy career. After Walter disrupts one of Dickens' readings, Dickens decides to share the story of Jesus Christ with him, hoping to bridge the gap between them. As Dickens narrates the story, Walter becomes captivated, experiencing the events of Jesus' life vividly Through the journey of Jesus, Walter and Dickens' relationship deepens, culminating in a bond of love forged through storytelling. (Source: Official site)

title: Candy Caries
synopsis: Ame is a child who loves sweets. But inside her mouth lived a cavity named Caries! Caries calls Ame "Mama" and acts completely unrestrained, using her teeth as furniture and even taking over her body. Ame is constantly being bossed around by Caries. Ame and Caries—a slightly unusual mother-daughter duo!? A slapstick comedy about their chaotic daily lives! (Source: Official site, translated)

synopsis: High school student and video game-lover Makoto Takatsuki dies in an accident and awakens in another world beside his classmates. However, he gains no cheat-like abilities, so he decides to become a "Magic Apprentice." Then Noa, a minor goddess, appears before him. After she pleads and begs him, he decides to become her first believer. The weakest boy in the class becomes the strongest alongside the minor goddess in this another world fantasy! (Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Hotaru no Yomeiri
synopsis: Satoko, the eldest daughter of the honorable Kirigaya family, has received many marriage proposals from men captivated by her beauty and grace. However, she has turned them all down due to her secret heart defect. Despite her condition, Satoko is still willing to find a husband to ease her beloved father's concerns. While on a stroll, Satoko is kidnapped by a group of mercenaries, one of them being Shinpei Gotou—a legendary assassin tasked with executing her. Satoko tries to bribe Gotou into freeing her, but it proves unsuccessful. Out of options, Satoko makes a desperate gamble: under the pretense of love at first sight, she asks him to marry her. Unexpectedly, Gotou takes the bait and vows to protect her. As the couple escapes to freedom, Satoko struggles to keep up the ruse and make sense of the mysterious man she has eloped with. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kkokdu
synopsis: Jacob, an 11-year-old boy who is looking for kokdu dolls to remember his last moments with his grandmother, accidentally enters the world of these dolls. The "kokdu", literally "funeral doll", a key element in the work, is a wooden doll that adorned the bier (a carriage that carried a coffin) in the funeral culture of the Joseon Dynasty. It was considered a being that accompanied and protected the deceased, so that they would not feel lonely on their way to the afterlife. These dolls, which appeared in various forms, such as warriors, servants, clowns, and guides, embody the philosophy of Joseon-era Koreans, who viewed death not as something to be feared, but as a warm farewell and a new journey. (Sources: etoday.co.kr)

title: Wang You Guo

title: Mamonogurai no Boukensha: Ore dake Mamono wo Kuratte Tsuyoku Naru
synopsis: Nobody wants "Grubby Forager" Rudd on their adventuring team. His nickname—and his stench—come from his constant treks into the Noxious Labyrinth to gather medicinal herbs, a job he survives only thanks to his status immunity skill. When he's finally recruited as a party porter, things seem to be looking up... Until a deadly dungeon monster appears and his fake allies use him as bait before abandoning him! Wounded, destitute, and barely surviving the attack, Rudd breaks a forbidden taboo to stay alive: eating monsters. But the more he devours, the more power he gains, kicking off a thrilling, adventurous gourmet fantasy! (Source: Square Enix)

title: Zui Hou Jue Ding Ai Shang Ni
synopsis: Two strangers, both proposed marriage to their respective girl/boyfriend, were rejected on the same day. They decided that the best way to deal with the rejection was to get drunk, real drunk. During the 24 hours of their crazy drunkenness, these two stranger became fast friends and got married... to each other. When they finally sobered up, they embarked on a mission to undo every crazy thing they did while they were drunk and prayed that their girl/boyfriend don't find out. (Source: MyDramaList)

title: Dogulwang
synopsis: Undercover behind enemy lines, Jooheon's newest plan to torment TKBM will involve taking them down from the inside! Stealing their relics and causing infighting is just the tip of the iceberg on what he'll do to make the group pay for their sins. But with the appearance of the Tower of Pride, Jooheon's skills in rage-baiting will truly be tested as he must pit the most fearsome warlords against each other! Will Jooheon Suh come out on top in the battle of the greatest conquerors of history? (Source: Yen Press)

title: Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen
synopsis: The 1910s. Iwamoto Kodo, a student at Suho Junior High School under direct command of the army, is investigating paranormal phenomena across the country as per military instruction. In a village rumoured to have "black snow," he meets a boy with special powers who believes them to be an illness; through Iwamoto's support, he realises they might have something in common and receives a recommendation to the school. Mysteries await Iwamoto at each place he visits–a romantic tale of this era begins to unravel! (Source: MAL News)

title: Zero Rise
synopsis: Zero Rise is about a group of young athletes who have lost their place in the basketball world due to past mistakes and harsh realities. In a society where the divide between wealth and poverty is stark, these determined players must battle against the odds in a cutthroat underground league known as "Zero Rise." As they fight not only for their dreams but for redemption and a shot at a brighter future, they must navigate treacherous challenges that demand both skill and integrity. In this unforgiving world, they are forced to discover what it truly means to rise from the streets—leaving them with one final question: will they find their second chance, or will the rules of survival break them? (Source: MAL News)
