title: Shen Qian: Qiangzhi Daodai
synopsis: In a fictional sci-fi world, alien beings known as "Hundred-Beak" intend to control the consciousness of all humanity. A young girl named Li Haila unites with a human force to resist the alien invasion, learns the mystery of her own origins, and ultimately thwarts the alien life form's plan, protecting the fate of humanity. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan
synopsis: When middle school student, Fukuga Kurumi's mother commits suicide after losing 20 million yen in FX trading (Foreign Exchange trading), she vows to recoup the money her mother lost "I'll easily get that much back!" Now, when she is a university student she makes her long-awaited debut in FX trading, unaware that the world she just entered could turn from heaven to hell in the blink of an eye. This is a cute and slightly dangerous story as it explains technical terms by thrilling market fluctuations as the chart drives up and down, which becomes more heated with the entry of quirky FX warriors: Yasuko Takane, Mochiko Kogane, and Mebuki Yamashi. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this world with unstoppable heartbeat moments and unrealized losses!? (Source: MAL News)

title: Path of Progress
synopsis: In this animated video, three real-life medical innovations currently in use—each helping save countless lives—are portrayed, showing how advancements in healthcare are enabling safe childbirth and healthy development for children. The animation was produced by A-1 Pictures, one of Japan’s leading studios, and directed by Yuki Morishita. (Source: Youtube)

title: World Is Dancing
synopsis: One does not need dance to live. In 1374, during the turbulent age when the Northern and Southern Courts were locked in conflict, the Northern Court's shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, was becoming an increasingly dominant force. Born the son of Kanami, head of the Kanze troupe of sarugaku performers, Oniyasha drifts through his days with a hazy question lodged in his heart: Why do people dance? His spirit remains clouded, until the day he encounters a dance that is truly "good." Curious, sensitive, and strikingly beautiful, the boy meets people, laughs, cries, confronts his own weaknesses, and slowly begins to shape a new form of dance for a world steeped in impermanence. (Source: Shochiku)

title: Onegai AiPri
synopsis: The new anime's story centers on Konomi Inori, a first year middle school student who just moved to the town of Onegai. At the town's plaza, Konomi prayed to the goddess statue to give her a chance to be an AiPri. After she prayed, she accidentally meets the famous AiPri Aoi Yumemiya and a mysterious talking stuffed toy with her named Fortu. It turns out that Fortu is looking for an AiPri who can make their wish come true, and when Konomi opened the special mirror pact that Aoi handed her, she gets the AiPri debut that she prayed for. (Source: ANN)

title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
synopsis: The film will center on a new character named Pantan. Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan. (Source: ANN)

title: Shishang Zui Qiang Lian Ti Lao Zu
synopsis: Ye Cangxuan, a supreme cultivator of the Body Refining Realm, was once invincible in the mortal world. He easily passed the Ascension Trial and ascended to the Immortal World. There, he learned that his homeland—the Nine Skies Continent—was on the brink of destruction. Without hesitation, Ye Cangxuan chose to return. At the same time, the Six Sects were collapsing. Demons and devils from the Outer Lands were poised to invade, and their spies had already infiltrated the Nine Skies Continent. Determined to change his homeland's fate, Ye Cangxuan embarked on a grueling quest. He reunited the Six Sects, broke into the Barbaric Wastes, wiped out demons and devils, and challenged the immortals themselves. In the end, he stood against the Sky itself. (Source: Youku)

title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
synopsis: Set around the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks displays, this story follows two high school students, Makoto and Akira. Though they live far apart in Tokyo and have never met, their lives are unexpectedly brought together by a single, mysterious painting of a firework. Drawn together by this strange connection, the two grow closer as time runs short. As the festival approaches, Makoto and Akira are faced with a decision that will change their futures forever. (Source: MAL News)

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
synopsis: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, a project that was started a few years ago, is the newly ENHANCED edition of the anime Dragon Ball Super. ENHANCED by the latest visual expression, every scene, especially the battle scenes, is even more immersive, providing a more faithful and detailed reproduction of the original work by Akira Toriyama, and it will deliver a quality that is sure to fully satisfy audiences. (Source: Official website)

title: Bao Ke Meng Donghua Tujian: Zhuanshun Binfen
synopsis: Fourth season of Bao Ke Meng Donghua Tujian.

title: Nippon Sangoku
title_english: Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
synopsis: In the near future, Japan has completely collapsed due to a mix of nuclear warfare, natural disasters, and widespread corruption that sparked a revolution. The country is now split into three warring superpowers. This new era of the Three Kingdoms Period sees diplomacy vanish, replaced by a harsh, relentless fight for power. Each territory is using its military strength and resources against the others in a desperate attempt for total control over the remnants of Japanese land. Aoteru Misumi is a low-ranking official who has stayed in the background for most of his life. He does not come from a prestigious military background or aristocracy, but Misumi has a strong ambition: to end the pointless bloodshed that afflicts the nation. He seeks to unify the fractured country, armed only with sharp insight and a persuasive voice that can rally the people. The legend of the man who will become a brilliant military strategist starts now. (Source: MAL News)

title: Megami "Isekai Tensei Nani ni Naritai desu ka" Ore "Yuusha no Rokkotsu de"
synopsis: The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications. The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples. (Source: MAL News)

title: Yuan Jing Zhi Dian
synopsis: Yi Wu was thrust onto the World Cup stage because of a single online "like." He then inexplicably appeared in a closed arena, where a countdown was implanted in everyone. To gain time to survive, they had to engage in a new, multi-strategy competition, escape perilous environments, and navigate secret chambers. This unique environment forced them to both cooperate and compete, and behind it all, a legend of a "spiritual kingdom" seemed to be circulating. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
synopsis: Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body. Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kumarba Season 3
synopsis: Third season of Kumarba.

title: Oneechan Gokko
synopsis: In the distant future, Kagami Village is a suburban mountain village that has been left behind by the highly developed science and technology in urban areas. "If you're not well behaved, a look-alike will come." Higure Akane, a middle school student living in this village where an old legend still remains, was looking forward to being reunited with her older sister Higure Sui, who has been released from the hospital after a year. However, shortly after her sister's release from the hospital, Akane receives a phone call. "The person in that house is not your older sister." (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Yani Neko
synopsis: Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.
title_english: I'm a Witch Who's Crush Requested a Love Potion
synopsis: Deep within the forest, a cozy and rather cluttered cottage sits on the lakeshore, housing a mysterious, feared witch. In truth, she is a lovely young woman named Rose, who has learned the art of potion-making from her wise grandmother. Rose cherishes her tucked-away life, yet there is a longing in her heart—for a handsome knight she once saw, Sir Harij Azm. For four years, Rose's feelings for Harij have lingered, but she can never act on them; witches live outside of human affairs and belong to no country or man. So, when Harij suddenly appears on her doorstep looking for a love potion, Rose is both surprised and heartbroken. Although another woman has captured the noble knight's heart, Rose decides to help him. But before crafting the potion, Rose sends Harij on a series of ridiculous quests for each ingredient, hoping to delay the inevitable and savor their fleeting time together. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Fukufuku no Chizu
synopsis: The short film tells the story of a French philosopher named Sophie, who visits Fukushima Prefecture for the first time to attend a friend's wedding. Sophie loses her way in Fukushima, but a mysterious "friend" and a "map" appear before her, and she follows their lead making detours and stops. Little by little, Sophie realizes that everything in Fukushima is a "culture" that has been created by someone and has been passed down through generations. (Source: ANN)

title: Luca
synopsis: The short film depicts a student, Nene, who encounters a shapeshifting entity by the name of Luca. (Source: anitrendz)

title: Lele Bianlidian
synopsis: Lele, a white dog, and Xiaoliang, a gray one-eyed cat, run a struggling convenience store. Besides selling goods, they also take on commissions to earn money. The story follows Lele and Xiaoliang as they complete various tasks, experiencing a series of small adventures together—stories about courage, understanding, and learning how to love and be loved. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Long Po Jiutian
title_english: Dragon's Triumph in the Celestial Realm
synopsis: The story unfolds in a fantastical martial arts world where ordinary people can unleash their mental and physical potential through continuous martial arts practice and internal energy cultivation. The protagonist, Lin Chen, is an ordinary martial artist of humble origins who strives for the pinnacle of skill. After experiencing injustice, his anger triggers his inner mental potential, entering a state of "Mind Awareness" similar to a quantum effect. However, this also allows him to witness the terrible danger his family faces in the future. Therefore, to protect his family and loved ones from fatal harm and to investigate the mystery of his father's disappearance, Lin Chen uses a mysterious list as a clue to uncover the truth behind everything, engaging in a perilous and arduous struggle against evil forces, thus weaving a legendary and moving tale. (Source: Youku, translated)

title: Thunder 3
synopsis: Three ordinary schoolboys come into possession of a DVD that supposedly opens a gateway to a parallel universe, but when their backs are turned Pyontarou's little sister Futaba passes through and gets kidnapped by the aliens that have overrun that version of Earth! Discovering that their cartoonish bodies make them supermen in the hyper-realistic parallel universe, the boys set out to rescue Futaba. (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e
synopsis: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island. On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured? A touching boy-meets-girl story. (Source: MAL News)

title: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume
synopsis: When Asley was young, he had dropped from the Magic Academy and was looked down by others. However by chance, he discovered a god medicine and obtained an immortal body. In order to take revenge on the people who made fun of him, he started to work on the research of magic and magical artifacts much different from those developed in the academy, and before he even noticed, 5000 years have passed and he became an ancient magic user. Losing his purpose life, Asley goes out on a journey with his familiar, Pochi, to see the world after 5000 years. With an unexpected turns of events after helping many humans, he is now living at the Magic Academy... How a 5000-year-old with young appearance Asley will live his second life? (Source: Official site)

title: Xiong Chumo: Niannian You Xiong
synopsis: Briar, Bramble and Vick encounter the legendary Year Monster, Nian, who bestows them with mysterious powers, thrusting them into the hidden, chaotic, magic-infused realm of Eve City. (Source: IMDb)

title: Xiong Chumo: Xiongxiong Bang Bang Tuan 4
synopsis: Something big is happening in Forest Town again!? Join the Helper Team for an immersive experience of traditional customs and feel the vibrant atmosphere of a traditional festival! (Source: Douban, translated)

title: Tang Zhi Zhi Yi
synopsis: A chance encounter between young Tang Zhi and a dragon maiden unexpectedly awakened his "Heavenly Eye"—allowing him to see gods and spirits roaming the mortal realm. These unique eyes led him into a world that coexisted with the mundane. Through unforgettable experiences, Tang Zhi made friends with all sorts of people and experienced laughter and warmth in seemingly ordinary yet subtly wondrous daily moments. An ordinary scholar, encountering and accompanying a group of gods and spirits with diverse personalities amidst the everyday life of the mortal world—this story of adventure, friendship, and growth is slowly unfolding. (Source: Bangumi, translated)

title: Xi Yangyang Yu Hui Tailang: Gu Guguai Jie You Guguai
synopsis: The anion and cation orbs were stolen by a mysterious wolf pack, pointing the finger of danger directly at the Strange Realm. The sheep and wolves tracked them down to the Strange Realm, only to discover that Handsome Guy and Black General had also been captured and taken to the Inner Earth beneath it. To rescue the two eggs, the sheep and wolves resolutely set off for the Inner Earth. In their adventures through the layers of the Inner Earth, the sheep and wolves met various explorers, fought against unknown monsters, and braved mysterious dangers. After countless battles and intrigues, the sheep and wolves finally uncovered the conspiracy of the ruthless preserved egg factory, rescued Handsome Guy and Black General, and, with the help of the two eggs, thwarted the crisis caused by the wolf pack, protecting the peace of the Inner Earth. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
synopsis: Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points! With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer! (Source: Shochiku)

title: Daikenja Riddle no Jikan Gyakkou
title_english: The Regression of Great Sage Riddle
synopsis: A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds! (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Chuldong! Super Wings 8
synopsis: Eighth season of Chuldong! Super Wings.

title: Chuldong! Super Wings 9
synopsis: Ninth season of Chuldong! Super Wings.

title: Dao Yao Xing
synopsis: Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception. However, neither is aware that the other is also an alien survivor whose home was destroyed by the "Void." This destined couple forms an alliance amidst suspicion and testing, not only searching for the treasures transformed from a lost spaceship but also confronting the ever-watchful cultivation world, seeking hope to defeat the "Void" amidst perilous circumstances. (Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Chaoji Fei Xia Wenhua Zhonghua
synopsis: A special season of Super Wings set in entirely in China.

title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka 6th Season
title_english: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? Season 6
synopsis: Sixth season of Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka.

title: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Yao Xing Shouhu Zhe 2
title_english: Balala the Fairies: Radiant Star Guardians 2nd Season
synopsis: A "dark veil" suddenly appears in the real world, prompting the little fairies to return to the Realm of Illusion to investigate. It turns out that the Realm of Illusion is being rebuilt, and Nightfall, along with her mysterious agents and the Dark Stars, has returned, attempting to dominate the magical world. (Source: Douban, translated)

title: Buonomo no Busutaman
synopsis: Have you ever wanted to swap your face for a new one If it was easy to do - as easy, quick and cheap as buying a burger at McDonald's - everyone would do it. As soon as you get tired of one, just get another. But there is something you should bear in mind. In order to get a new face, you must first throw away your old one. (Source: Official Site)

title: Hyakki Yakoushou
synopsis: Ritsu inherited his sixth sense from his grandfather, along with a demon guardian named Blue Storm. Strange things just seem to happen around these two, and it's left to them to get to the bottom of all these mysterious events. Each story is independent but features recurring characters you'll come to know and appreciate as they, each in their own way, try to deal with things 'not of this world'. (Source: MU)

title: Namidaame to Serenade
synopsis: On rainy days, Hina Katagiri always dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy, but she assumes these thoughts are nothing more than a childhood fantasy. Now a high school student, she focuses on her club activities and protecting her great-grandmother's necklace. While at school, Hina is inexplicably transported to the backyard of a mansion, where she is greeted by one of its inhabitants, Takaaki Hongou. He mistakes the girl for his fiancée, Hinako Kitamine, but Hina, believing she is in a dream, plays along with the misunderstanding. It is when Hina comes face-to-face with the real Hinako that she realizes the severity of her situation: somehow, she has been sent to the year 1907. In addition, she has lost her heirloom necklace at Takaaki's house. With Hinako's assistance, Hina continues to masquerade as her in order to access the Hongou household. However, Hina's plan begins to fall apart when she starts to develop feelings for Takaaki, all while the path to her fo

title: Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu
synopsis: After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession! Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"? A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a yandere. (Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Xiuxian Zhe Dazhan Chaonengli
synopsis: A supreme expert from the cultivation world accidentally transmigrated to a world of superpowered individuals. Here, most people possess various superpowers and are known as "heroes," spending their days fighting monsters and saving the world. (Source: Youku, translated)

title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
synopsis: Yuri, a pretty Japanese girl, is ecstatic after passing her college entrance exam and having her first kiss with her childhood friend-turned boyfriend. However, her luck soon changes. She starts to notice that water becomes agitated whenever she goes near it. One night, hands appear out of a puddle on the street and drag her into the water! Transported to an ancient village in the Middle East, she is then captured by armed troops and taken to the Queen's palace for a human sacrifice. (Source: VIZ Media)

title: AI Shitteru
synopsis: A reality dating program from Gyeonggi-do that is airing in 2070. "Find true love through the attraction of your heart!" AI and human panelists date solely through conversation. "You can tell whether the other person is an AI or a human by declaring that you are in love." (Source: Vimeo, translated)

title: Huhuan Shaonu
synopsis: Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, utterly unremarkable. Until she met Li Zhao… Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream. This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments! (Source: Bangumi, translated)

title: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku
synopsis: The Sage of Wind, Ephtal is a reincarnated human, coming from modern Earth. Reincarnated in a new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish. But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic! However, in a surprising turn of events, he discovers that magic has terribly declined. In this era where powerful spells are a rarity, his talentless self is now completely unmatched! From the depths of powerlessness to the peak of power, the talentless but peerless mage's journey to the top starts now! (Source: Manga UP!, edited)

title: Nihyaku-nen no Yume wo Mita.
synopsis: During the final days of the Edo period, Jo Niijima risked his life to travel to America in search of freedom. Fortunately, with the support of many kind-hearted individuals in this new land, he was able to receive a democratic and advanced education across three different schools. While studying abroad, Niijima realized that for Japan to become a modern nation, it was essential to have an education system that fostered individuals filled with autonomy, freedom, and a strong conscience. Upon returning to Japan, he dedicated himself to transplanting an American-style school into his homeland, taking on the challenge of establishing Japan's first private university. Ultimately, his ambition and dream of founding a university were not realized during his lifetime. However, that dream has been continuously passed down and lives on within the students, alumni, and faculty of present-day Doshisha. (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Crayon Shin-chan Movie 34: Kikikaikai! Ora no Youkai Bake-shon
synopsis: The 34th Crayon Shin-chan movie.

title: Huhuan Shaonu Special: Xiang Zuo de Shi Daodi Shi Shenme
synopsis: Special episode of Huhuan Shaonu.

title: Mahoutsukai Rosé no Sado Life
synopsis: The story begins when Rosé is transported from another world to Japan. Right after arriving, she is attacked by a bird, but she's saved by a local resident named Sana Tsuchiya. Since Rosé has just arrived and lacks both money and any sense of her surroundings, she ends up moving in with Sana. At first, after watching TV at Sana's house, Rosé assumes she has been transported to Tokyo—but in reality, she is on Sado Island. (Source: MAL News)

title: "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu
synopsis: Elsa, daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives a marriage proposal from Julius, an elite aristocrat. "Why would such a noble man marry me?" Elsa was perplexed, but after the wedding, Julius, who until then had been kind and gentle, changed his mind! (Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: The Horrors' Horror Home
synopsis: An ancient vampire who has thrived on human blood for centuries meets a modern Japanese wraith spreading curses through television screens. These two beings, transcending the boundaries of East and West, forge a covenant of love that births a daughter inheriting their blood and terror... (Source: YouTube)

title: Garou Densetsu: CotW - Nightmare Geese
title_english: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Nightmare Geese Trailer
synopsis: Nightmare Geese animated trailer by Masami Obari Fates intertwine after more than 26 years as Rock Howard, Terry Bogard, and more vie for the legacy of the late Geese Howard, whose ghostly and nightmarish presence continues to haunt South Town. Experience the ominous aura of Nightmare Geese, and the intense action that ensues once the city’s heroes encounter him—all in the dynamic visual style that world-renowned animator Masami Obari does best. (Source: YouTube)
themes: Martial Arts | Super Power | Video Game

title: Dandelion
synopsis: Set within the Send-Off Department of the Japanese Angel Federation, Dandelion follows "Angels" Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane as they scramble to track down Earthbound spirits—souls unable to move on and find peace—and gently guide them to pass on. The angels find themselves struggling to meet their daily tasks. However, Tetsuo Tanba and his leader, Misaki Kurogane, who make up the 21st Division's Dandelion Clan, chose to take things at their own pace: instead of rushing through cases, they take time with each spirit, listening to their regrets and helping them resolve what's holding them back. One day, they encounter the Earthbound spirit of an elderly man who is running at full speed, trying desperately to escape. (Source: Netflix)

title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
synopsis: Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. He discovered that he still hadn't returned a book he borrowed 10 years ago. He ended up having to work part-time at the library to pay for it. This is the beginning of a manga that makes you want to go to the library after you read it. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Cang Yuan Tu Qianzhuan: Dongning Fu de Xiatian
title_english: Prelude of The Demon Hunter: Dongning Prefecture in Summer
synopsis: When disaster strikes, how can we sincerely awaken the phoenix? (Source: Douban, translated)

title: Kin to Tetsu
synopsis: Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
synopsis: In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out. After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks... Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Zhe Tian Movie: Bei Guan Zhan Wang Teng
title_english: Shrouding the Heavens: The Imperial Path
synopsis: Ye Fan and Wang Teng, two top geniuses, face each other in a fated battle. The Wang family from Beiyuan arrives with great power, while the Ji family’s elder is secretly plotting something, and Ji Ziyue is forced into a political marriage. Surrounded by enemies, Ye Fan becomes everyone’s target. As the Ancient Sacred Body clashes with ancient powers, who will rise as the true Great Emperor? (Source: WeTV)

title: Guimi Zhi Zhu: Wu Mian Ren
synopsis: After his resurrection, Klein, now known as Sherlock, becomes a private detective. While taking on cases, he inadvertently provokes a spy organization. With the help of his bodyguard Sharron, as well as the assistance of Audrey and others, he faces many enemies, including the powerful Ambassador of Intis. In a later case, Klein unexpectedly discovers ruins from the Tudor dynasty. While continuing his detective work, Klein searches for clues to his advancement while also pursuing his enemies, Lanevus and Intis… (Source: Tencent, translated & edited)

title: Bless
synopsis: In a boisterous classroom, 15-year-old Aia Udagawa's thoughts are far from the topic at hand. While his classmates select him as a model for the Aoi Festival Artist Contest due to his past modeling experience, Udagawa watches Jun Sumisaki, a tall and awkward girl who seems embarrassed about her unique freckles and impressive height. They are paired as model and stylist—but Udagawa defeatedly mourns his abandoned dream of becoming a makeup artist. Udagawa has long convinced himself he has no talent, and Sumisaki lacks the confidence to hold her head high and flaunt her stunning features. Even so, Sumisaki proposes that they switch: Udagawa will have all creative freedom, and she will boldly strut the runway like her mother once taught her. Notable figures from the glamor industry will be watching, but it may prove to be the push Udagawa needs to return to the fashion and beauty scene and conquer it alongside his favorite model. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ling Long 2nd Season Qianzhan Pian: Changye Jiang Zhi
title_english: Ling Cage 2 Preview: The Long Night Is Coming
synopsis: It tells the story about how Bai Yuekui finds Lu Sheng, AI intelligence ASH, Mana origin, and origin of Clotho. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Bousai Namazun no Jishin wa Kanarazu Yattekuru
synopsis: One night, Naoyuki's family watches a disaster prevention anime DVD distributed at school. Even though Bousai Namazun teaches them about the Tokai, Tonankai, and Nankai earthquakes that could strike at any time, the older brother, Naoyuki, can only think, "Is an earthquake really going to happen?" The next day, a major earthquake occurs while their father and mother are away. Even though they want to go to an evacuation shelter, the furniture throughout the house has fallen over, and the living room door is warped, so they cannot open it by themselves. "What if Mom doesn't come back...?" his younger sister, Sayaka, starts to cry. Is their father, who went to a seaside factory, safe? The two wait anxiously for help. At that moment... (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Football Animals
synopsis: Only one minute left in the second half. The RED ANIMALS are slick, pushing through the deadly defensive line of the BLUE BEASTS. And just when you think it's all over, the ball goes up in the air. Who will smell sweet victory? (Source: YouTube)

title: J⇔Ｍ
synopsis: J is a legendary hitman who is feared in the underworld as "untouchable." One day, while walking on the street, he accidentally collides into a lonely elementary school girl named Megumi. However, because of the accident, they switch bodies. J is now forced to go through the life of the schoolgirl Megumi, while Megumi is now forced to go through the life of the hitman J. One chaotic and comical situation after another ensues as they go through each other's life. (Source: MAL News)

title: Game Sekai Tensei "Dankatsu": Gamer wa "Dungeon Shuukatsu no Susume" wo "Hajime kara" Play suru
synopsis: After finding himself reincarnated as the protagonist of the god-tier game "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", Zephyrus is far from intimidated. Instead, he's absolutely thrilled! As a seasoned gamer who knows every nook and cranny of this world, he now has the chance to live within a massive system featuring an unprecedented 1,021 playable classes and over 400 different endings. Armed with an encyclopedic knowledge of the game's mechanics, Zephyrus wastes no time enrolling in the Labyrinth Academy, the central stage where the real adventure begins. He has his sights set on a single goal: securing the fabled "Hero" class. Alongside his childhood friend, whom he guides toward the Alchemist path, Zephyrus is ready to sweep up rare loot and power-level at a breakneck pace! (Source: MAL News)

title: Komekami! Girls
synopsis: This is the story of the seven-sister unit "Komekami! Girls," children of the rice deity, born from the tradition: "In a single grain of rice, seven gods reside." When their mother(the deity of rice, or the rice-god queen) was called back in haste to the celestial realm and no longer able to return to the earthly realm they search for her traces using Usa City (Oita Prefecture) as their base, and teleport to Hachiman shrines throughout Kyushu island. As they solve local problems, they learn about food, take part in cooking battles, and grow.

title: Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?
synopsis: Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Junket Bank
synopsis: Karasu Bank is one of Japan's leading banks, boasting the third-highest operating profits in the country. Akira Mitarai is a young employee in his second year at the bank's central branch. His exceptional math skills allow him to instantly spot accounting errors but also make his day-to-day life incredibly boring. One day, Akira is suddenly transferred to the Special Operations Department's "Appraisal Unit," which he is told is a key department within the bank. Suspicious of his transfer and the unfamiliar department, he is told by his new boss that the bank actually operates a massive underground casino, and that the Appraisal Unit is the department responsible for managing this gambling as well as the gamblers who participate in it. But these gamblers are putting more than just their money on the line, with their very lives serving as collateral to play! Higher risk means higher rewards, but at the top level losing is a death sentence. Overwhelmed and confused by the strange state

title: Isekai Tensei Soudouki
synopsis: Bard Cornelius: the son of a nobleman of Mauricia, an empire located in a parallel universe. But Bard is no ordinary boy—he's got three souls packed into one body! Aside from his own consciousness, he's got Oka Sanai, a miserly samurai, and Masaharu Oka, a high school otaku who loves animal ears. With his extra knowledge of military tactics and business acumen, Bard's ready to cheat his way to the top! Get ready to enjoy the manga version of this hit isekai light novel series! (Source: One Peace Books)

title: Sword Art Online: Unanswered//butterfly
synopsis: The world's first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality. Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman. Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…? (Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Moshi, Korekara Umareru no Nara
synopsis: Nameless twins land on a certain planet. Led by a guide, they venture into a mysterious world in search of their mother, whom they have never met. However, their path begins to crumble under the weight of their mother's grief. (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Tank Chair
synopsis: Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes! (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car wo Shoukan shimashita
title_english: The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
synopsis: Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint. However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, [Survival], as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savors gourmet cuisine to her heart's content... Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...? (Source: MU)

title: Kanata kara
synopsis: Noriko Tachiki has dreamt of a beautiful fantasy land for some time, though her friends think it is only her imagination. One day, on her way home, Noriko stumbles upon a bomb disguised as a paper bag that explodes right in front of her. However, instead of dying, she is transported to a mysterious forest full of strange plants and creatures. As she begins navigating through the woods, Noriko is suddenly attacked by a giant, worm-like monster. Fortunately, she is saved by Izark Kia Tarj, a swordsman who does not speak her language. Lacking the strength to survive on her own, Noriko decides to follow her stoic savior, taking the opportunity to learn the foreign land's language and be more useful to Izark. Unbeknownst to her, Noriko is a crucial piece of an ancient prophecy. She is "The Awakening"—a being destined to unleash the greatest evil known as the "Sky Demon." title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
title_english: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
synopsis: Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length. However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media. Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing. (Source: MAL News)

title: Migawari Reijou wo Sukutta no wa Reikoku Mujihi na Koori no Ouji no Ai deshita
synopsis: As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside? (Source: MangaPlaza)

"I want you to protect me," she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent! (Source: Kodansha)

title: Cheongchun Blossom: Uliui Bom
synopsis: Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter—love blossoms in all seasons. (Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Panlong
synopsis: The continent of Yulan is a magical world teeming with wondrous creatures and dazzling magic. One day, Linley Baruch, a young nobleman from the impoverished town of Wushan, stepped into his dusty ancestral home and inadvertently obtained a seemingly ordinary ring—the Dragon Ring—thus changing his life forever. With the help of the Ringwraith Delin Corvort, Linley embarks on his legendary journey, and a great magician is born. The boy from the small town, through his relentless struggle and unyielding spirit, constantly strives for higher realms, step by step reaching the pinnacle of power through trials that teem with life and death. (Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon
title_english: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage
synopsis: Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say... "Will you marry me?!" (Source: Yen Press)

title: Shiranuhi
synopsis: The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse. (Source: Anime News Network)

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Yi Shou Mi Cheng
synopsis: The world is an illusion, but love is real. At eighteen, Gao Yang accidentally discovers the cruel truth of the world: his family and friends are all terrifying "beasts," and these "beasts" will kill anyone who discovers the truth. Facing the "beasts'" frenzied attacks, Gao Yang, on the verge of death, activates a mysterious system and awakens his talent Luck, thus beginning a game of survival between lamb and wolf… (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Li Xiongmao
synopsis: The story follows Li Xiongmao, a human boy raised by the demon race, who is ordered by his master to leave Black and White Mountain to kill three enemies who destroyed the demon race. In the process of investigating the truth, he gradually uncovers the conflict between humans and demons, the secrets of the dynasty, and the mystery of his own destiny. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Zhu Shen Yu Xi
synopsis: Sixteen gods descended to the human world, tearing the world into countless fragments, transforming them into a life-or-death chessboard called the "Game of Faith." Humans became players, forced to enter bizarre instances every seven days, struggling to survive within the rules set by the gods. Cheng Shi, trapped on a rooftop in a desperate situation at the start, first believed in fate, then succumbed to deception, becoming a clown priest whose every word was a lie. The price was being plagued by misfortune, but his ability was to turn fiction into reality with lies. He used his silver tongue to deceive his teammates and manipulate the gods, running a tightrope between "faith" and "betrayal," rising from a pawn to become the one wielding the pieces. Opposing destinies, sixteen faiths, and six professions combine to create endless gameplay; the instances have diverse themes, the rules are fraught with danger, and the battles of wits and reversals are nested layer upon layer. synopsis: The King returns, unrivaled in the world! It is a story about falling to the bottom and returning to the top. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Yi Jian Du Zun
synopsis: Life and death are nothing to me; if you're not convinced, then fight! All gods, Buddhas, and immortals are but a sword's edge. The young Ye Xuan, through a series of fortuitous events, unlocks the Prison Tower, a supreme treasure of the heavens, changing his destiny and embarking on the path of sword cultivation! (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Changsheng Xianyou
synopsis: This is a story about time, life, and humanity. The protagonist, Lin Changsheng, is cursed with the mayfly curse, living only one day every three years, born in the morning and dying at dusk, his life as fleeting as a mayfly. After unexpectedly learning that the curse can be broken, Lin Changsheng and his companion, Tong Zhihuan, embark on a journey to find a way to break it. Along the way, they meet new friends, awaken their magical powers, fight demons, find family and love, unravel the mystery of their origins, and experience the joys and sorrows of human life. (Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou
title_english: The Case Files of Biblia Bookstore
synopsis: Hidden away in a corner of Kamakura is an unassuming secondhand bookstore, the Biblia Antiquarian Bookshop. Shinokawa Shioriko, the owner of the shop, is an overly shy young and beautiful woman who doesn't fit the image of a used bookstore and often has trouble interacting with customers. While customer service isn't her strong point, she more than makes up for it in other ways. Using her exhaustive knowledge and unrivaled passion for literature, she unravels the secrets and mysteries of the antiquarian books that come into her shop. This is a story of secrets and rare books. (Source: Nanodesu Translation)

title: Around 40 Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki
synopsis: Forty-year-old Satoshi Osako is a farmer in the Japanese countryside—and a hardcore player of Swords & Sorceries, an online VRRPG. The day he finally manages to defeat the game's final boss, it curses him with its dying breath and kills him in real life! With a little help from a carefree goddess, Satoshi finds himself reincarnated into a mysterious new world as his in-game character, the incredibly powerful Great Sage known as Zelos Merlin. He accordingly decides to use his newfound powers to...continue living a quiet life on another farm! But first, he'll have to fight his way out of the vast, dangerous forest he woke up in—thanks a lot, goddess—and it won't be long before he's running into bandits, getting roped into teaching a young noble girl magic, and more. Will the almighty Great Sage be able to conquer the toughest quest of all: getting some peace and quiet? (Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun
synopsis: In middle school, Hiro Momose was bullied and forced to be an errand girl for delinquents. Now a high school freshman, she is hoping to turn over a new leaf. Although the requirement states that each student must join a club, the clumsy Hiro is rejected by every club she has visited. Because of this, she ends up joining the "Helper's Club," a group on the verge of disbanding with Dan Ichikura as its sole member. On the surface, Ichikura seems like the perfect boy—boasting good grades, athleticism, and a reliable nature. However, he harbors a secret that hits a bit too close to home for Hiro: he was once a delinquent. When she finds out, Ichikura swears her to secrecy. Now, Hiro must avoid returning to her middle school days and make this chance encounter work out for them both. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
